initialization: Locked offline Refined-PSE v2 tokenizer and its matching offline DiffGRM checkpoint from the Stage05 refined_joint recipe
local_attention_location: History SID embeddings after the hard/ST embedding branches join, before item_mlp; belongs to the recommender parameter group
training: Stage05 full alternating protocol: five recommender warmup epochs, then one tokenizer phase plus three recommender epochs per cycle, up to 45 logical epochs; each tokenizer phase uses 96 batches
